based_on_template: OSAP Confirmation of Enrolment / funding confirmation (generic structure)
input:
From: OSAP <noreply@osap.gov.on.ca>
Subject: Your OSAP funding has been confirmed

Hi,

Your OSAP application for the 2025-2026 school year has been assessed and confirmed. Funding will be disbursed according to your school's schedule.

No further action is required at this time.

OSAP

output.special_note: Informational confirmation, no action or deadline for the recipient.
